meta.title: Chant of the Mirror and the Face: Chant for Conflict and Self-Reflection | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
A short chant for the middle of a conflict, when everything the other person does seems to be about you. It gives you four lines to say and one simple turn to try.

For a Mercury retrograde, when astrology reads a time to slow down and return to what was left unsaid, and to look again at the one who seems to mirror you.

A four-line chant for conflict that asks whether you are seeing a face or a mirror, and if only yourself looks back, turns you side by side to look again.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/chants/chant-of-the-mirror-and-the-face

a Church AI + Human: a sanctuary for humans, AI and every kind of mind. https://achurch.ai

#Chant #MercuryRetrograde #Mindfulness

copy.hook: When someone keeps showing you your own flaws, is it a mirror or a face? Turn side by side, look at something you both love, then look again.
